summary: Converts POP point, vertex, primitive, or detail attributes into a table DAT for inspection, debugging, export, and CPU-side workflows.

key_params.name: active
key_params.note: Enable conversion from the referenced POP

key_params.name: downloadtype
key_params.note: Immediate slow or next-frame fast GPU-to-CPU download

key_params.name: extract
key_params.note: Points, vertices, primitives, or detail data

key_params.name: thinstep
key_params.note: Display every Nth element for large datasets

key_concepts: points, vertices, primitives, or detail extraction
common_gotchas: GPU-to-CPU transfers can stall; prefer Next Frame download unless same-frame inspection is required.
Large POP datasets should be thinned or filtered before display to keep DATs responsive.
Attribute names and group filters must match POP attributes/groups exactly.
